entities.name: Dargo
entities.description: Giant pirate from an unknown plane who still waits on an island for rescue.

events.summary: Dargo tears the figurehead off the ship to prove his devotion and is welcomed aboard.
events.quote: He proved his devotion by tearing the figurehead off the ship 's prow

events.summary: The ship splits in two under Dargo's weight in a storm; Dargo wades to an island and waits for rescue.
events.quote: the deck buckled under Dargo's immense weight before quickly giving way, splitting the boat in two
